errors.evidence: The description does not mention what each of the three lines represents, i.e., it omits the legend information which links the colors to the categories (38.1, 38.2, 38.3).

errors.text_span: има пунктиран стил и няма използвани маркери
errors.evidence: The blue line is a solid line, not dotted ('пунктиран'), and it does have circular markers, contrary to the description.
The value of the blue line in 2020 is approximately 125,000, not 150,000.
The gray line does not decrease from 2018 to 2019; it increases significantly from about 220,000 to about 275,000.

errors.text_span: след което леко се покачва и достига стойност около 225000 през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This description of the gray line's trend after 2019 is a gross oversimplification. The line actually drops sharply from 2019 to 2021 before rising again in 2022. Describing this as a slight increase ('леко се покачва') is misleading.
